name: Ring of Battle Fatigue
body:
Aura faint enchantment; CL 5th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of battle frenzy. When the wearer becomes involved in combat, however, she becomes fatigued in the second round as the rage effect abruptly ends. The fatigue lasts for twice the length of the total number of rounds the wearer may use the rage ability per day.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it followed by a lesser restoration, restoration or greater restoration. This causes the ring to crumble into dust.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of battle frenzy

Identification DC 30
False Identification DC 20
